# Archived workflows (HOSTKEY era)

One-shot flip/setup/probe workflows applied on the HOSTKEY box (82.21.7.48) in June–August 2026.
The box was terminated 2026-08-25; the flips they applied live on as `calibration_constants`
rows (re-seeded on the home server 2026-08-27). Kept for the audit trail — the run journals are
in `verivio-clode/_tasks/T1-074/`. GitHub does not read workflows from subdirectories, so nothing
here is dispatchable. `sync-signal-weights` was a Time4VPS↔HOSTKEY comparison tool — both hosts
are dead, the tool is obsolete by construction.
